name: io.github.emberspun/longform-memory-mcp
description: Constant-size memory for writing a long document. Chapter 1000 costs the same tokens as chapter 10. Runs locally: no account, no API key, no network.

environmentVariables.name: LONGFORM_MEMORY_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Which document this memory belongs to. One name per book.

environmentVariables.name: LONGFORM_MEMORY_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Where memory is stored. Defaults to ~/.longform-memory.
